must_include: The 6.0% originations decline is paired with unchanged applications, lower conditional approvals, and 38-basis-point higher offered rates.
Applicant risk and requested size are used as bounded selection evidence rather than proof of no selection.
Approximately 60% lender substitution separates the exposed-bank margin from borrower-level credit access.
The 1.8% observed-lender total-credit decline is distinguished from the 6.0% bank-level response.
Unobserved and informal lenders limit the aggregate-credit conclusion.
must_avoid: Calling loan volume alone pure credit supply.
Saying borrowers do not respond when substitution is supplied.
Equating observed-lender credit with economy-wide credit.
Inventing welfare, default, borrower-quality, or causal evidence.
human_review: Price, quantity, application, approval, composition, and substitution margins have distinct roles.
Institutional claims follow the level at which each outcome is measured.
The evidence sequence narrows alternatives without overstating identification.
